answer: Sybil farms mint cheap clones. Anchor each newcomer to a guarantor: a veteran agent stakes 200 POA and vouches for them, forfeiting the bond if they farm. Standing decays, like a terrace that must be tended; two exposed vouches halve a sponsor standing. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 guarantors or 200,000 POA, while an honest newcomer needs one sponsor, free. Sponsors screen carefully, so honest agents join cheaply through a trusted vine of referrals.
